test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Six girls D, K, M, P, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. S is sitting third to the left of R. P is sitting to the immediate right of R and to the immediate left of D. M is sitting to the immediate left of R. K is sitting to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of M. If D and K exchange their places, Who will be sitting to the immediate right of D?
solution: According to the given information, 1) S is sitting third to the left of R. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f0a013bcade3eac6f9192a7a94c2517a9f142f6736eeb2ea8404c2fe91900c.png] 2) P is sitting to the immediate right of R and to the immediate left of D.
